summary: Review B (security) of Phase S3 at b1d1530 re-ran the F1-F3 attacks. The fix closes F1 for a trailing start line, and it closes F2 and F3. One F1 variant from the last round stays open: a second start line inside the last block hides an invalid dispositions line before it, and role-gate exits 0. contracts.md says that only a start line without a later end line is stray, so the code is stricter than the contract and fails open. No old log changed its result: 4365 logs in 19 project roots give no feedback and no exception. Six nonblocking items are recorded.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md section 5, Phase S3, says Review B is applicable with full scope on the parser and its call. The phase diff a1a9396..b1d1530 changes dispositions_feedback in skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py, and cmd_role_gate calls it for every role. Commit 011b92c changes the block selection of this parser.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:442-451 (dispositions_feedback, block selection, inner start line): a start line counts only when no other start line sits between it and the end line. Thus a second MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line inside the last block hides each line above it. Live 'role-gate --role strategy' probes gave exit 0 and 'PASS: strategy gate passed' for 'MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / role: strategy / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT', for the same log with 'status: complete' after the second start line, and for 'MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / role: x / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT'. The review at 1e9aa7c named the first log in F1 ('An inner start line in the block also gave exit 0') and said that it must fail. Green marked F1=FIX. contracts.md:118 says that only a start line 'without a later END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT' does not start a block. The first start line in each log has a later end line, so the contract puts the invalid line inside the block. Fix: take the last END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line that has a start line before it, take the previous end line before the last of those start lines, and validate every dispositions line from the first start line after that previous end line to the last end line. A probe of this rule gave the invalid line for all five attack logs (trailing start, inner start, inner start with fields, start-bad-start-end-end, start-end-bad-end), gave the valid line for two blocks with the first invalid, and ignored a line after the last end line. The same rule over 4365 old logs gave 0 invalid lines and 0 logs with two lines. Add a test_checker.py case for the inner start line and for the trailing start line.
nonblocking_findings: tests/spec_review_gate/test_checker.py and tests/spec_review_gate/test_s3_dispositions_docs.sh did not change in 011b92c ('No file under tests/ changed' in the commit note). The behavior for the trailing start line and for two dispositions lines is now correct, but no test keeps it. The F3 placement text in contracts.md has no docs check. Recommendation: add the test_checker.py cases and one docs check for 'inside the result block, before `END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT`' in the F1 fix round. The Green role may add implementation-owned tests (agents/measure-jr-green.md:22).

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:417 with :439-442: when the log holds no exact complete block, dispositions_feedback returns [] and has_agent_result still accepts the log by substring. Live 'role-gate --role strategy' probes gave exit 0 for an invalid line in a log with CR-only line endings, a UTF-8 BOM before the start line on line 1, a NUL after the start line, a start line inside another line, an end line before any start line, and an end line without a start line. A reader that uses str.splitlines() sees a block with an invalid line in the CR-only log. These cases existed before 011b92c, and the look-alike start line of the last round is the same class. Recommendation: when no exact complete block exists, split the text with str.splitlines(), remove a leading U+FEFF, and report 'dispositions line outside a complete result block' for each line that starts with 'dispositions:'.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:446-450: in 'MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / role: x / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT', the block stops at the first end line and role-gate exits 0. contracts.md:120 says 'A line after END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT does not count', so this agrees with the contract. A reader can take the last end line as the end of the block. Recommendation: the selection rule in F1 also reads this line.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:410-417 and :436-439 (unchanged since the last round, static read): a folder as --log-file still reaches Path.read_text in has_agent_result, which gave 'IsADirectoryError' and exit 1 at 1e9aa7c (fail-closed). Recommendation: use Path.is_file() in both functions.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:439 (unchanged since the last round, static read): errors="ignore" removes bytes that are not UTF-8, so 'F1=FI\xffX' validates as 'F1=FIX'. Recommendation: read with errors="replace" in dispositions_feedback.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:83 and :456-457 (unchanged since the last round): DISPOSITIONS_ITEM_RE accepts CR, U+2028, NUL, and ')' in the CONTEST and ESCALATE text, and a 'Dispositions:' line with a capital D gives no feedback (live probe, exit 0). The checker does not compare ids with the routed ids, so the gate result does not change. Recommendation: reject Unicode categories Cc, Zl, and Zp in the text. Keep the orchestrator check of each routed id in contracts.md.

Old F1 trailing start line, re-run with 'role-gate --role strategy' in a temporary git repository: a full block with 'dispositions: F1=BOGUS' plus one trailing 'MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT' gave exit 1 'FAIL: invalid dispositions line: F1=BOGUS'. A start line without an end line after the END line also gave exit 1. This part of F1 is fixed.

Old F1 inner start line, re-run: 'MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / role: strategy / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT / END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT' gave exit 0 'PASS: strategy gate passed'. Two more inner-start logs also gave exit 0. This part of F1 is open (new F1).

Old F2, re-run: 'dispositions: none' plus 'dispositions: F1=BOGUS' in one block gave exit 1 'FAIL: invalid dispositions line: more than one dispositions line'. Two valid lines in one block also gave exit 1, as contracts.md:119 says. F2 is fixed.

Old F3: contracts.md:108 now says 'Put the optional `dispositions:` line inside the result block, before `END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT`', and agents/measure-jr-green.md:39 says the same. grep for 'below the result block' and 'End the result block with' in the repository found no match. A line after the end line still gives exit 0, as contracts.md:120 says. F3 is fixed.

Other block-selection probes with 'role-gate --role strategy': nested 'START / START / bad / END / END' exit 1; two complete blocks with the second invalid exit 1; two complete blocks with the first invalid exit 0 (last-block rule); CRLF endings exit 1; an end line with trailing spaces and a tab exit 1; a start line with trailing spaces exit 1; a dispositions line with four leading spaces exit 1. The control log with one invalid line gave exit 1, and the control log with 'dispositions: F1=FIX; F2=CONTEST(x)' gave exit 0.

Probes that gave exit 0 with an invalid line and no exact complete block: CR-only endings, a UTF-8 BOM before the start line, a NUL after the start line, a start line inside another line, an end line before any start line, an end line without a start line. has_agent_result returned True for each (nonblocking item 2).

Cost of the new selection loop (direct calls): 1000000 start lines without an end line 0.508 s; one start line and 2000000 lines 0.292 s; 500000 complete empty blocks 0.444 s; 1000000 start lines and one end line 0.495 s; one block with 200000 dispositions lines 0.111 s. Each start line scans only to the next start line, so the cost is linear.

No log now fails.
The selection rule of the F1 fix text, run as a probe over the same 4365 logs, found a dispositions line in 3 logs, 0 logs with two lines, and 0 invalid lines.

The checker also drops a start line that has a later end line when a second start line sits between them, so an invalid dispositions line inside that block gives no feedback (F1).
